sloka: एवमुक्तस्तु लङ्केशः शम्भुना स्वयमब्रवीत् ।प्रीतो यदि महादेव वरं मे देहि याचतः ।। ७.१६.४१ ॥
transliteration: evamuktastu laṅkeśaḥ śambhunā svayamabravīt ।prīto yadi mahādeva varaṁ me dehi yācataḥ ।। 7.16.41 ॥

translations.english: Thus spoken to by Shambhu, the lord of Lanka himself replied, "If you are pleased, O Mahadeva, then grant me a boon as I ask."
